build_mrc_head: build a Multiple Region Classification transformer head with a region classifier neural network module
create_region_classifier: create a region classifier using Linear, GELU, LayerNorm, and Linear layers for image region classification
run_mrc_forward: run the MRC forward pass to compute masked hidden outputs and region classification predictions
test_mrc_kl_loss: test the MRC head KL divergence loss computation with soft labels and log softmax predictions
review_mrc_cross_entropy: review the MRC head cross entropy loss fallback when use_kl is disabled
